sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Grantham Road
89 That portion of the Province of British Columbia being 0.4 km on each side of the midline of the Telkwa-Morice Road, commencing from the intersection of the midpoints of Walcott Station Road and the Telkwa-Morice Road and continuing in a northerly direction to a point 3 km distant. [en. B.C. Reg. 162/87, s. 25.]
